events.factual_description: Jazz at Lincoln Center presents Catherine Russell and Friends on October 2–3, 2026 at 7:30 PM in Rose Theater at Frederick P. Rose Hall. The concerts celebrate Russell's 70th birthday and her musical lineage; the official ticketing page for October 3 lists Cyndi Lauper as special guest. Additional friends and collaborators are not yet named on the main event page.

en.why_it_matters: Russell's 70th birthday is unusually well matched to Jazz at Lincoln Center: her own career carries a direct family line into early big-band and Armstrong history, while her singing keeps blues, swing and American song alive without turning them into repertory museum pieces. The October 3 addition of Cyndi Lauper gives one night a genuinely cross-genre dimension rather than simply adding another jazz guest.
en.trip_verdict: S for New York. Worth building a regional NYC night around, with October 3 the stronger target because of Cyndi Lauper. Not S+ because this is a two-night birthday celebration rather than a singular farewell or one-off historic reunion.
en.listen_before: Live At Jazz At Lincoln Center (Live); Harlem On My Mind (Bonus Track Version)

es.why_it_matters: El cumpleaños 70 de Russell cae en el contexto perfecto: su propia historia familiar conecta directamente con la era de las grandes bandas y Louis Armstrong, mientras su manera de cantar mantiene vivos el blues, el swing y la canción estadounidense sin convertirlos en museo. La incorporación de Cyndi Lauper el 3 de octubre le da además a esa noche una dimensión cross-genre real, no sólo otro invitado de jazz.
es.trip_verdict: S para Nueva York. Sí vale construir una noche regional alrededor del concierto; el 3 de octubre es el objetivo más fuerte por Cyndi Lauper. No S+ porque son dos noches de celebración de cumpleaños y no una despedida o reunión histórica irrepetible.
es.listen_before: Live At Jazz At Lincoln Center (Live); Harlem On My Mind (Bonus Track Version)
